parsed.reason: Multiple violations: (1) Claims Hale will "keep things straight" across calendars, which is the receipt language that should only describe pulling dates, not an ongoing commitment; (2) Uses "I'll keep" suggesting Hale will maintain the sync, rather than just asking if they want the calendar pulled in; (3) The phrasing "Want me to pull them in?" is awkward and could be read as Hale claiming to pull/register the events; (4) Should focus simply on asking if Sam wants their calendar added to the kids' year, not wrapping it in promises about keeping things straight; (5) The message should be shorter and more direct about the actual ask.
